summary: The refactor generalises the descent machinery but stops short of the one fact both quotients need: the nondegeneracy argument is duplicated verbatim, hand-rolling character evaluation instead of using the existing `mem_radical_iff`. One term proof also silently rides on `restrict`'s definitional transparency.
